The inner ring represents "Max Ambiguity" and is divided into three slices: a medium cyan/blue slice labeled "Max: 1" at 38.0%, a lighter cyan slice labeled "Max: 2" at 39.0%, and a very light blue/pale slice labeled "Max: 3" at 14.2%, with an additional visible portion accounting for the remainder. Percentage labels are displayed directly on or adjacent to each slice. Two separate legends are provided to the right of the chart, one for each ring, with color swatches corresponding to the categories. The outer ring uses darker blue tones while the inner ring uses lighter cyan and pale blue tones, creating a visual distinction between the two measures. The slices within each ring appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order by size, with the two largest segments in each ring being relatively close in proportion.
